subject: polity
title: Parliament of India
description: Composition, sessions, quorum, money bill, joint sitting, and key procedures

content.overview: Parliament is the supreme legislative body of India. It consists of the President, Lok Sabha (House of the People), and Rajya Sabha (Council of States).
keyPoints: LOK SABHA Composition: Max 552 = 530 (States) + 20 (UTs) + 2 (Anglo-Indians, nominated — provision now abolished by 104th Amendment); current elected strength 543
RAJYA SABHA Composition: Max 250 = 238 (States & UTs) + 12 (nominated by President for expertise in literature, science, art, social service); current 245
Sessions: Budget (Feb-May), Monsoon (Jul-Aug), Winter (Nov-Dec); President summons; max 6-month gap between two sessions
Quorum: 1/10th of total members (Lok Sabha: 55, Rajya Sabha: 25)
Ordinary Bill: Must be passed by both houses; deadlock → Joint Sitting under Article 108, presided by Speaker

Money Bill (Article 110): Can only be introduced in Lok Sabha with President's recommendation; RS can only recommend changes within 14 days; Speaker's decision on Money Bill is final; NO joint sitting for Money Bill
Constitution Amendment Bill (Article 368): Special majority in each house; NO joint sitting provision
Joint Sitting (Art 108): Called by President; NOT applicable for Money Bills and Constitutional Amendment Bills

Parliamentary Committees: Public Accounts Committee (22 members: 15 LS + 7 RS), Estimates Committee (30, all LS), Committee on Public Undertakings (22: 15 LS + 7 RS), Departmentally Related Standing Committees (DRSC — 24 committees, 31 members each: 21 LS + 10 RS)
PAC is chaired by an Opposition member (convention since 1967)

mnemonics.trick: MONEY BILL = Lok Sabha Only + No Rajya Sabha Veto
mnemonics.explanation: Money bills can only be introduced in Lok Sabha. Rajya Sabha cannot reject or amend them, only recommend changes within 14 days.
Three parliamentary sessions: Budget (Feb-May), Monsoon (Jul-Aug), Winter (Nov-Dec)

quiz.question: What is the quorum of Lok Sabha?
Money Bill can be introduced in which house?
quiz.explanation: Money bills can only be introduced in Lok Sabha under Article 110

quiz.question: How many nominated members are in Rajya Sabha?
quiz.explanation: Rajya Sabha has 12 nominated members with expertise in literature, science, art, and social service

quiz.question: Joint Sitting of Parliament is provided under which article?
quiz.explanation: Article 108 provides for Joint Sitting, called by the President; NOT applicable for Money Bills and Constitutional Amendment Bills

quiz.question: The Public Accounts Committee has how many members?
quiz.explanation: PAC has 22 members (15 from Lok Sabha + 7 from Rajya Sabha); chaired by an Opposition member

quiz.question: Maximum gap between two sessions of Parliament cannot exceed:
quiz.explanation: The maximum gap between two sessions of Parliament is 6 months
